description:
## 10,000 sq ft of open sky in Downtown LA

A raw rooftop canvas above the studio — open sky, city views and natural light. Bring your own build or shoot it as is.

### Good to know
- We control only what's inside our space, not the building.
- A team member will walk you through the space at the start of your booking and stays close by if you need anything.
- Your booking time is your setup **and** cleanup time — please be out by the end to avoid overtime (1.5x rate).
- Parking: $10 all-day lot at 1023 S Los Angeles St + metered street parking on Main, Olympic, 11th & Los Angeles St.
- Sound: no complaints — feel free.
rules: Booking time includes setup and cleanup.
